title.narrative: Leading from The South (2021-2025) - Linking and Learning

description.narrative: Facilitating and/or supporting the critical spaces and opportunities for learning and exchange is acritical part of WFA’s mandate on contributing to feminist movement building in Asia. WFA will organise two kinds of spaces: (a) strategicthematic convergences, and (b) specific skill building training and workshops for WFA grantee partners and the four LFS 2.0 funds.

Primary Target Group: Grassroots, intermediate and large southern women´s rights organisations (SWROs), LFS 2.0 Consortium members, Dutch Ministry of Foreign AffairsSecondary Target Group: Women's Funds and other allies

title.narrative: [Input] Facilitating and supporting needs-based spaces and opportunities for linking and learning

description.narrative: This indicator is linked to SC 3 and captures linking and learning grants and spaces. The details on spaces can be found in detail in the LFS activity.

title.narrative: 3. Total numbers of grants given by WFA for Linking and Learning

description.narrative: The linking and learning grants is an ongoing small grant process wherein partners and non-partners can apply for specific learning, network and advocacy spaces.

comment.narrative: The aim is to provide a minimum of 20 grants each year for the five years of the LFS program.
This includes L&L grants which were disbursed till December 2024.
